message: Your argument is built on a foundation of handouts and government dependency, and you know it. You're trying to shame me into accepting your failed ideology, but it's not going to work. You're not interested in the truth, you're only interested in advancing your own agenda. So, go ahead and keep repeating yourself, but at the end of the day, your solutions are not addressing the real issues.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent's ideology 'failed' and accuses them of 'shaming' and not being interested in 'the truth'. This directly attacks the opponent's character and motives rather than engaging with their argument.
